paper.title: AutoDroid: LLM-powered Task Automation in Android
paper.central_claim: AutoDroid handles arbitrary tasks on any Android app without manual effort, using app-specific exploration knowledge; reports 90.9% action accuracy and71.3% task success, improving accuracy and cost over GPT-4-powered baselines.

evidence.quote: capable of handling arbitrary tasks on any Android application without manual efforts.
evidence.support_explanation: Original broad system claim, not retrospectively narrowed.

evidence.quote: AutoDroid randomly explores the target apps and extracts UI transition graphs from them.
evidence.support_explanation: App-specific exploration precedes test use; not an unseen-environment experiment.

evidence.quote: Then, we can find k most similar simulated tasks in the app memory
evidence.support_explanation: Embedding retrieval feeds onclick functionality hints to frozen cloud LLMs.

evidence.quote: Additionally, we provide the correct action to choose
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher rationale generation sees target action; deployment does not.

evidence.quote: We merge UI elements based on two rules:
evidence.support_explanation: UTG successor equivalence and common interactive ancestor drive structural compression.

evidence.quote: The actual completion rate in the real-system can be higher than the reported results, but we do not include real-system results since determining task completion can be ambiguous.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicitly no real-system outcome results: 71.3% is offline trajectory agreement, not online success.
GPT-4 action match 90.9 vs 54.5; same model but different observation/action scaffolds.
Vicuna CoT and MoTiF interactions: no simple monotone CoT-only story.

evidence.quote: AutoDroid reduces LLM calls by 1.2 per task resulting in an overall decrease of 13.7%
evidence.support_explanation: Operational call saving; offline preparation must also be counted.

evidence.quote: Our shortcuts correctly guide LLMs in 75% of cases. Considering only the correct shortcuts
evidence.support_explanation: 38.02% step saving conditioned on correct shortcuts, not unconditional end-to-end efficiency.

evidence.quote: For every app, it takes about 0.5-1 hour to generate the UI Transition Graph
evidence.support_explanation: Preparation cost substantial; synthesis 5-10min and one-time embedding also reported.
Failure taxonomy is sampled; no repeated task-success uncertainty estimate.

evidence.quote: Note that the app and task in the MoTiF dataset
evidence.support_explanation: Authors assert MoTiF disjointness, but memory still built on evaluated apps.

evidence.quote: a new benchmark for memory-augmented Android task automation with 158 common tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 158 tasks/13 apps; headline 71.3% reported offline completion.

evidence.quote: AutoDroid determines the importance of a UI element in the app memory based on the similarity between its simulated task and the current user task.
evidence.support_explanation: Selection is relevance, not execution-verified quality acceptance.
Named task-automation nearest baselines; original independent papers not supplied in reference pack.

evidence.quote: AutoDroid achieved a precision of 75.0% and a recall of 80.5%.
evidence.support_explanation: Risky-action gate measured but imperfect; not a validated task-success judge.

signatures.object: App-specific UTG and functionality memory used by cloud-model policy
signatures.information: Black-box UI structural tree plus offline exploration of the SAME target app; synthetic element functions and path successors available; not screenshot-only or unseen-app inference.
signatures.operation: Randomly explore -> UTG -> LLM per-element task/function summaries -> Instructor-XL cosine top-k retrieval -> onclick future-function hints in current HTML -> LLM id/action -> executor
signatures.conditions: Stable app/UI-state matching; explored route reaches useful functionality; LLM correctly interprets hints.
signatures.feedback: Observed exploratory state transitions; generated descriptions, not ground-truth task-success reward.
signatures.selection_rule: Top-k semantic similarity at task time; shortcut when max similarity > gamma. No reported quality rejection gate.
signatures.selection_data: Offline explored target app and current instruction
signatures.persistence: UTG, simulated task table, UI function table and embeddings in App Memory, reused across tasks.
signatures.later_use: Runtime retrieves routes for later user tasks on the same app.
signatures.claimed_effect: Memory ablation improves action and whole-reference-sequence agreement.
signatures.failure_boundary: Coverage holes, erroneous functionality descriptions, state drift and incorrect shortcuts; no independent unseen-app transfer.

signatures.information: Android hierarchy and automatic traversal of scrollable content, including initially off-screen nodes.
signatures.operation: Prune invisible/noninformative nodes; merge same-successor UTG actions and same-interactive-ancestor leaves; auto-scroll and merge screens; shortcut stored routes
signatures.output: Simplified HTML discrete ids; fewer model queries
signatures.conditions: Merging preserves action-relevant distinctions and executor can recover mapped elements.
signatures.selection_rule: Deterministic merge criteria, not learned outcome selection
signatures.failure_boundary: Successor equivalence may obscure side effects; baselines lack automatic scroll information; shortcut saving reported on successful shortcuts only.

signatures.information: Training teacher is given known next action and trajectory; extra MoTiF input/completion labels; runtime gets task, history and current UI only.
signatures.operation: Synthesize task-action pairs from UTG; GPT-4 rationalizes provided target action; mix input/completion MoTiF examples; fine-tune Vicuna.
signatures.conditions: Synthetic rationales reflect real action semantics, mixture avoids premature completion.
signatures.feedback: Trace-derived target actions plus teacher-generated rationale
signatures.selection_rule: No explicit execution-validation filter reported; not iterative self-improvement.
signatures.selection_data: Exploration-derived tasks plus unrelated MoTiF action types
signatures.failure_boundary: Teacher rationalization noise not independently validated; single model size; no reported independent online evaluation.

gap.author_gap: Manual demonstrations/API effort, lengthy GUI trees, missing app-specific route knowledge and expensive LLM queries.
gap.checked_gap: Opaque intermediate navigation lacks lexical relation to goal; reference UI trees expensive; authors show concrete calendar route and named baseline weakness.

claims.text: Arbitrary Android tasks without manual effort; headline 90.9% action accuracy and 71.3% task completion.
claims.setting: 13 tool-style Android apps; 158 manually annotated DroidTask tasks; GPT-4; temperature .25; teacher-forced/reference UI sequence.
claims.baseline/control: GPT-4 LLM-framework 54.5% action agreement; same underlying model, different structural observation and action space.
claims.selection_vs_test: Target apps explored before evaluation; no independent app holdout; task-level synthetic overlap unmeasured.
claims.result/denominator: Authors report 90.9% action agreement; 71.3% whole-reference-sequence completion, excluding completion-determination step in Fig7; action count not recovered from text.
counterevidence: E06: no real-system completion results; valid alternatives rejected; explored apps not transfer.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Improved offline action/reference-trace agreement in these explored apps, not 71.3% independently verified online success.

claims.text: App memory and generated CoT improve automation.
claims.setting: Cloud memory on/off; Vicuna7B fine-tuning CoT/MoTiF ablations.
claims.baseline/control: Memory removal; Table3 no Mo/no CoT/no both.
claims.selection_vs_test: Training/synthesis target-app data; MoTiF asserted unrelated.
claims.result/denominator: Vicuna full 57.7/41.1 action/sequence; no Mo 51.9/29.8; no CoT 20.6/.6; neither51.9/31.6.
counterevidence: No known-action-rationale correctness audit; nonmonotone interaction; no equal-information memory alternative.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Offline signal improves this implementation with mixture dependence; not retained self-improvement or general online transfer.

claims.setting: Cloud API and Vicuna smartphone/edge server; five paired prompts, ten API-latency samples.
claims.selection_vs_test: Five random baseline prompts; shortcut savings separately computed only for correctly guided subset.
claims.result/denominator: 625.3->339 tokens; calls -13.7%; shortcut correctness75%, correct-only step saving38.02%; app prep .5-1h+5-10min.
counterevidence: Five-prompt small latency sample; output truncation case P5; no amortized cost curve.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Reported token/call savings with explicit preparation/conditional-cost limitations.
